feature: Guarded retail/wholesale autosave in an existing product editor
behavior: Save settled base and persisted-variant retail/wholesale fields in the current store; remain in the editor.
Keep whole-form Save for metadata, new variants, creation, unit changes and legacy single-price mode.
Store preparation remains an explicit previewed/confirmed action using saved server prices.
Persist exact request keys before sending, serialize edits, reject stale versions and check unknown outcomes before recovery.
A receipt does not replace current data during page recovery. Known canceled attempts cannot apply later.
Do not overwrite newer local field input when acknowledging an earlier response.
No-op writes preserve shared-price inheritance; an actual local edit affects only the changed price kind.
Check fresh permissions, organization, active assortment, plan, currency, rate, unit and variant scope.
databaseChanges: No schema migration. No customer data repair or balance changes. Existing canonical store-price columns are reused.

scopeLimits: Does not silently propagate edits to other stores.
Does not autosave product name, images, unit changes, unsaved variants or product creation.
Does not change the existing quick-price upsert API; required-version protection is enforced by the new autosave endpoint and already guarded whole-form path.
Automatic tests use synthetic data and disabled external providers. Production verification is read-only.
infrastructureNotes: Early local runs interrupted by disk exhaustion, missing installed dependencies or an insufficient heap are excluded from successful counts. Related tests reran successfully after restoring exact lockfile dependencies.
Local checks were switched to sequential, one-CPU, low-priority execution after the owner reported laptop heat.
Temporary browser fixture first used a disconnected recipient; the existing permission boundary correctly prevented application. Final transfer verification uses a permitted connected recipient.
Unpublished legal and marketing work is excluded from the production commit.

referencePrinciples.applied: Make saved/unsaved/pending state explicit; this is not a claim that Shopify automatically saves product prices.
Optimistic version checks, bounded field patches and idempotent retries.

release: CI, release-gate and exact custom-domain SHA must still be verified after push; receipt is kept under the private QA directory.
